pois.name: Transamerica Pyramid
pois.description: William Pereira's 1972 tapered tower (260m). San Francisco's most recognisable silhouette. The ground-floor Transamerica Redwood Park is free and open daily.

pois.name: Ferry Building Marketplace
pois.description: A 1898 Beaux-Arts terminal (71m clocktower) reborn as SF's finest food hall. Farmers' market Tuesday/Thursday/Saturday. Slanted Door, Acme Bread, Recchiuti chocolate.

pois.name: Salesforce Tower
pois.description: César Pelli's 326m tower (2018), SF's tallest building. The top-floor dome hosts a free arts programme — visible from the Bay Bridge. At dusk it glows through fog.

pois.name: Saints Peter & Paul Church
pois.description: 1924 Roman-Italian Gothic twin-towered church in North Beach, where Joe DiMaggio had his wedding photos taken after marrying Marilyn Monroe in 1954.
